name: People
description: Who to reach out to (the People page). A person's file opens as their profile, with the timeline drawn from its Timeline section.
forAgents: A lasting fact the user tells you about themselves or someone goes where it belongs: `people.remember`; something that happened with someone: `person.timeline-add`.

person.description: a person's profile: how you know them, where they live, their birthday, when you were last in touch

people-due.description: the people overdue for a check-in

people-wants.description: everyone with a want_to: people to call, meet or write to

people-birthdays.description: the next birthdays, soonest first: the date, how far off and the age they turn

people-group.description: the people with some relations, and when you were last in touch with each

relations.description: the relations to show (partner, family, friend...); everyone when left out
